evidence: The metal organic precursors were held in stainless steel bubblers. Heated at 120 °C and 110 °C respectively, TaCp(= N tBu)(NEt2)2 and Ta(=NtBu)(NEt2)3 were evaporated inside the reactor using nitrogen (99.9999%) as carrier gas. ... The pressures of the bubblers, maintained at 4 × 103 Pa were measured by Baratron capacitance manometers. Tantalum nitride based thin films were deposited at temperatures ranging from 220 °C to 450 °C depending on the precursor, by alternatively exposing the substrate surface to Ta precursor in its vapour phase and NH3 (99.96%), separated by N2 (99.9999%) purging, following the sequence × s (Precursor) –13/30 s (Purge) –8 s (NH3)–13 s (Purge).
